events.text:
Verified — 3/3 tests pass.

What I fixed in thermostat-buggy.ino:
1. Compile error: `const float THRESHOLD_C = 30.0` was missing its semicolon (line 22).
2. Logic bug: the LED condition was inverted — `bool ledOn = t < THRESHOLD_C` turned the LED on when the room was cool. Changed to `t > THRESHOLD_C`, so the LED is on above 30 C and off at/below it (matching the "exactly 30 C is not too hot" test).

Test results:
  hot room turns the LED on    PASS  (35 C → LED=ON, pin A = 1)
  cool room keeps the LED off  PASS  (20 C → LED=OFF, pin A = 0)
  exactly 30 C is not too hot  PASS  (30 C → LED=OFF)
  Compile: ok, 23% flash / 7% RAM
